content: {"phoneNote":"Phone is a tidy typographic page, but a joinery business with no photo of a single kitchen or piece of furniture anywhere is a serious loss, and the hero stacks a CTA plus full contact block on top of the fixed bar.","desktopNote":"Desktop hero has a large dead band under the headline/contact card, the 1979 numeral is oversized and bleeds across the slice, and the long one-column list plus three-step row leave wide empty right halves.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":2,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":2,"spacing":2,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Add a strong photo of finished furniture or the workshop in the first screen on both viewports, and small images next to each product in \"Kaj izdelujemo\".","Tighten the desktop hero and \"1979\" block: shrink the numeral, remove the empty band below the hero, and align the about text with the number.","Reduce duplicated contact info: the hero contact card, header buttons and footer all repeat phone and directions; keep one primary action per screen."],"blockers":[]}
